29.10.4 𝐸𝑐ν2⁢m⁡(i⁢(z−K⁡−i⁢K′⁡),k′2),
𝐸𝑐ν2⁢m+1⁡(i⁢(z−K⁡−i⁢K′⁡),k′2),
𝐸𝑠ν2⁢m+1⁡(i⁢(z−K⁡−i⁢K′⁡),k′2),
𝐸𝑠ν2⁢m+2⁡(i⁢(z−K⁡−i⁢K′⁡),k′2),

For these results and further information see Erdélyi et al. (1955, §15.5.2).
